ideas.pitch: An interactive WebGL art installation that shatters a simulated computer screen to reveal a breathing, organic garden underneath, perfectly blending digital UI with fine art.
ideas.problem_statement: The world we experience is often limited by the frames we create. Break one such frame and express what lies beyond it through an interactive digital experience.
ideas.title: Aperture Protocol
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the high weight on 'Art Direction & Visual Aesthetics (25%)' and 'Creativity & Originality (30%)', this project uses pure CSS and Three.js to create an unforgettable live visual punch.

ideas.pitch: A scrollytelling frontend experience where standard text paragraphs slowly dissolve their HTML borders, letting typography bleed into generative ambient audio and canvas particle flows.
ideas.problem_statement: The world we experience is often limited by the frames we create. Break one such frame and express what lies beyond it through an interactive digital experience.
ideas.title: Echoes Beyond the Margin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with 'Conceptual Depth & Storytelling (20%)' by using modern CSS scroll-driven animations to make the layout itself tell the story of breaking out of boundaries.

ideas.pitch: A psychological UI experiment where users click to shatter rigid grid-based dashboard panels, transforming sterile productivity UI into an emotional, fluid, paint-splatter dreamscape.
ideas.problem_statement: The world we experience is often limited by the frames we create. Break one such frame and express what lies beyond it through an interactive digital experience.
ideas.title: The Paned Mind
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines UI/UX with Fine Arts, hitting the exact interdisciplinary sweet spot the jury expects, and features a foolproof live browser demo that stuns in seconds.

ideas.pitch: An interactive digital stained-glass window where each pane represents a cultural taboo or systemic boundary; clicking them shatters the glass and floods the screen with unconstrained color palettes.
ideas.problem_statement: The world we experience is often limited by the frames we create. Break one such frame and express what lies beyond it through an interactive digital experience.
ideas.title: Chroma Breach
ideas.why_it_could_win: Maximizes points in 'Creativity & Originality' and 'Interaction & User Experience' by turning a static cultural theme into a rewarding, tactile web toy.

ideas.pitch: A generative browser experience that starts as a strict, boring spreadsheet grid and slowly mutates into an infinite abstract art gallery based on user mouse gestures and keystrokes.
ideas.problem_statement: The world we experience is often limited by the frames we create. Break one such frame and express what lies beyond it through an interactive digital experience.
ideas.title: The Unframed Canvas
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers an impressive live demo where ordinary productivity tools are subverted into fine art, matching the exact cross-disciplinary spirit of an Alankaar fine arts challenge.
